Unit 8: Probability & Combinatorics

### 8. Permutations, Combinations & Conditional Probability (Page 488)
- Fundamental Counting Principle.
- Permutations: $P(n, r) =  rac{n!}{(n-r)!}$.
- Combinations: $C(n, r) =  inom{n}{r} =  rac{n!}{r!(n-r)!}$.
- Conditional Probability: $P(A mid B) =  rac{P(A cap B)}{P(B)}$.
- Bayes' Theorem and Independent Events.
